guidance: We continue to see significant opportunity across existing and emerging markets and remain on track for our targets of 580+ restaurants by March 2028.
So I just wanted to check whether this kind of a target is relevant or applicable for FY '27 as well?
capex: Strong same -store sales growth translated into healthy margin expansion with operating EBITDA growing 29% year - on-year during the quarter.
As we approach our 500th restaurant milestone, our expansion strategy remains disciplined and focused on long -term value creation.
risks: This was achieved despite absorbing over 190 basis points of inflationary pressure across commodities, utilities and employee costs.
I would argue we've actually reduced a lot of discounting and that helped us improve some of the inflationary pressures we had without touching too much on the pricing.
focus: We are focused on strengthening our value leadership, staying relevant to customers and delivering a great restaurant experience every time they visit us.
Our restaurant expansion strategy remains disciplined, and we remain focused on building presence in the right markets through the right formats while maintaining prudent capital allocation.
The momentum we saw through the quarter has continued into October, giving us confidence as we enter the festive season.
